\chapter{Boolean Analysis — Recursive Reduction}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.BooleanAnalysis.LMN.RecursiveReduction
\section{Overview}

This module collects the helper lemmas used in the recursive proof of the LMN circuit
reduction. It relates restrictions, the structural parameters of a circuit (depth, size,
fan-in) to those of its children, expresses the evaluation of an AND/OR node under a
restriction, and combines compression with the switching lemma to bound the decision-tree
depth of a node after a further random restriction.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
\section{Declarations}

% LMN.restrictFn_composeRestr is documented in Depth3Switching.tex (same private
% lemma name appears in this module too; the binding label lives there to stay unique).

\begin{lemma}[Depth of a child of a Boolean-circuit gate]
\lean{LMN.children_depth_le}
\label{LMN.children_depth_le}
\leanok
\uses{BoolCircuit.Circuit, BoolCircuit.Circuit.depth}
\difficulty{4}
Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables of the form of a single gate — an AND gate
or an OR gate — applied to a list of child circuits, and let $c$ be one of those
children. If the depth of $C$ is at most $d$, then the depth of $c$ is at most $d - 1$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Bound on the total size of a gate's children]
\lean{LMN.children_size_sum_le}
\label{LMN.children_size_sum_le}
\leanok
\uses{BoolCircuit.Circuit, BoolCircuit.Circuit.size}
\difficulty{2}
Let $g = \mathrm{node}\,(\mathit{isAnd},\, cs)$ be an internal gate of a Boolean circuit
on $n$ variables, with $cs$ the list of its child subcircuits, and let $s$ be a natural
number with $\mathrm{size}(g) \le s$. Then the sum of the sizes of the children,
$\sum_{c \in cs} \mathrm{size}(c)$, is at most $s - 1$ (truncated natural-number
subtraction).
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Children inherit the fanin bound]
\lean{LMN.children_maxFanin_le}
\label{LMN.children_maxFanin_le}
\leanok
\uses{BoolCircuit.Circuit, BoolCircuit.Circuit.maxFanin}
\difficulty{4}
Let $g$ be an internal gate of a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables — either an AND gate
or an OR gate — applied to a list of child circuits, and suppose its maximum fanin is at
most $w$. Then every child circuit occurring in that list also has maximum fanin at most
$w$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Child circuit size bounded by parent]
\lean{LMN.child_size_le_parent}
\label{LMN.child_size_le_parent}
\leanok
\uses{BoolCircuit.Circuit, BoolCircuit.Circuit.size, LMN.children_size_sum_le}
\difficulty{4}
Let $g$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables that is a single gate — an AND or OR gate
applied to a list of child circuits — and let $c$ be one of those children. If the size
of $g$ (its total number of gate and literal nodes) is at most $s$, then the size of $c$
is at most $s - 1$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Restriction commutes with gate evaluation]
\lean{LMN.restrictFn_node_eval}
\label{LMN.restrictFn_node_eval}
\leanok
\uses{BoolCircuit.Circuit, BoolCircuit.Circuit.eval, SwitchingLemma.Restriction, SwitchingLemma.restrictFn}
\difficulty{2}
Fix $n$ variables and let $C_1,\dots,C_k$ be a finite list of Boolean circuits on them,
let $\rho$ be a restriction, and let $b$ be a Boolean flag. For a Boolean function $f$
write $f_\rho$ for its restriction by $\rho$, the function $x \mapsto
f(\rho.\mathrm{extend}\,x)$. Form the circuit node with children $C_1,\dots,C_k$, read
as an AND gate when $b$ is true and as an OR gate when $b$ is false, and let $g$ be its
evaluation. Then the restriction of the gate's evaluation agrees, as a Boolean function,
with the gate applied to the restricted evaluations of the children: for every
assignment $x$,
\[
g_\rho(x) =
\begin{cases}
\displaystyle\bigwedge_{i=1}^{k} (C_i)_\rho(x) & \text{if } b = \mathrm{true},\\[1ex]
\displaystyle\bigvee_{i=1}^{k} (C_i)_\rho(x) & \text{if } b = \mathrm{false},
\end{cases}
\]
where $(C_i)_\rho$ denotes the restriction by $\rho$ of the evaluation of $C_i$, an
empty conjunction is $\mathrm{true}$, and an empty disjunction is $\mathrm{false}$.
\end{lemma}

Let $cs$ be a finite list of Boolean circuits on $n$ variables, let $\rho$ be a
restriction on those variables, and let $l$ be a natural number. Suppose that for every
circuit $c$ in $cs$, the restricted function $x \mapsto c(\rho.\mathrm{extend}\,x)$ has
decision-tree depth at most $l$. Then there is a CNF formula $\psi$ of width at most $l$
that computes the restriction of the AND of $cs$: writing $g$ for the AND gate applied
to the circuits in $cs$, one has $\psi(x) = g(\rho.\mathrm{extend}\,x)$ for every
assignment $x : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \mathrm{Bool}$.
\end{lemma}

\uses{BoolCircuit.Circuit, BoolCircuit.Circuit.eval, DNF, DNF.eval, DNF.width, LMN.compression_or_of_dnfs, LMN.restrictFn_node_eval, SwitchingLemma.Restriction, SwitchingLemma.dtDepth_le_implies_small_dnf_cnf, SwitchingLemma.restrictFn, dtDepth}
\difficulty{4}
Let $c_1,\dots,c_m$ be Boolean circuits on $n$ variables, let $\rho$ be a restriction of
those variables, and let $l$ be a natural number. For a Boolean function $g$ write
$g\!\restriction_\rho$ for its restriction by $\rho$, the function $x \mapsto
g(\rho.\mathrm{extend}\,x)$ that fixes each coordinate assigned by $\rho$ and reads the
remaining coordinates from $x$. Suppose that for every child $c$ among $c_1,\dots,c_m$
the restricted function $c\!\restriction_\rho$ is computed by some decision tree of
depth at most $l$. Then there is a DNF formula $\varphi$ of width at most $l$ that
computes the restriction $F\!\restriction_\rho$ of the OR gate $F$ over the children,
i.e.\ $\varphi(x) = F\!\restriction_\rho(x)$ for every assignment $x$, where $F$
evaluates to the disjunction of the values $c_1,\dots,c_m$.
\end{lemma}

  {LMN.restrictFn_composeRestr}

  {pdf-fc447f326910-p012-b004}
\uses{BoolCircuit.Circuit, BoolCircuit.Circuit.eval, CNF.eval, DNF.eval, LMN.and_children_have_cnf, LMN.composeRestr, LMN.or_children_have_dnf, LMN.restrictFn_composeRestr, LMN.switching_bernoulli_dtDepth_cnf_general, LMN.switching_bernoulli_dtDepth_dnf_general, SwitchingLemma.Restriction, SwitchingLemma.bernoulliRestrProb, SwitchingLemma.restrictFn, dtDepth}
\difficulty{5}
Fix $n \ge 1$, an integer $l \ge 1$, and a natural number $t$, and write $D(g)$ for the
decision-tree depth of a Boolean function $g$ on $n$ variables, that is, the least depth
of a decision tree computing $g$. For a function $g$ and a restriction $\rho$ on the $n$
variables, let $g\!\restriction_{\rho}$ denote the function obtained from $g$ by fixing
each coordinate to the value $\rho$ assigns it and leaving the coordinates $\rho$ marks
free as inputs. Let $c_1,\dots,c_m$ be Boolean circuits on $n$ variables, and let $F$ be
the function computed by a single AND gate, or by a single OR gate, applied to
$c_1,\dots,c_m$; the bound below holds for either gate. Suppose a restriction $\rho_1$
satisfies $D\!\left(c_i\!\restriction_{\rho_1}\right) \le l$ for every $i$. Draw a
random restriction $\rho_2$ under which each of the $n$ variables is independently left
free with probability $p = \tfrac{1}{40 l}$ and otherwise fixed, taking each of the
values $0$ and $1$ with probability $\tfrac{1-p}{2}$, and let $\rho_1 \circ \rho_2$ be
the composite restriction that keeps every value fixed by $\rho_1$ and applies $\rho_2$
to the coordinates $\rho_1$ leaves free. Then
\[
\Pr_{\rho_2}\!\left[\, D\!\left(F\!\restriction_{\rho_1 \circ \rho_2}\right) > t
\,\right]
  \;\le\; \left(\tfrac{1}{2}\right)^{t} + \exp\!\left(-\frac{n}{120\, l}\right).
\]
\end{lemma}
